--repo.description: One connected repository: show its settings

workspace security-scan show.description: Show the PR security-scan and AI review settings, workspace-wide, for every connected repository (--repos) or one (--repo). Any member may read.

--ai-review.description: AI review (LLM security review and triage)

--allow-author-approval.description: PR authors may run `@uselumo resolve` / `approve` on their own PR (default on); off = only other write-access accounts

--auto-pause-after.description: Every push to a PR gets an automatic AI review until N commits are reviewed (default 5, 0 = never pause; a PR’s own `pr review --resume --limit` wins)

--base-branches.description: With --repo (repeatable; replaces the list, "" clears): also review PRs whose base branch fully matches; the default branch is always reviewed, ".*" = all

--confirm.description: The user approved the listed changes

--description-check.description: With --repo: the pre-merge description check (default warning; follows the repository's PR template if it has one)

--description-keyword.description: With --repo ("" clears): with --review off, review PRs whose description contains it

--disable-all.description: Turn every layer switch off at once

--drafts.description: With --repo: review draft PRs too (off = wait for ready for review)

--enable-all.description: Turn every layer switch on at once

--ignore-title.description: With --repo (repeatable; replaces the list, "" clears): skip PRs whose title contains it (case-insensitive)

--ignore-users.description: With --repo (repeatable; replaces the list, "" clears): never auto-review PRs by this author (exact, case-sensitive; beats every other rule)

--issue-assessment.description: With --repo: the pre-merge check that judges each requirement of the linked Lumo task (Goal, Done when items) and of the issues the PR description closes or links as Addressed / Not addressed / Unclear (default warning; not applicable without a linked task or issue; unmet ones are flagged in a review comment)

--json.description: Emit { switches, platform, effective } as JSON

--labels.description: With --repo (repeatable; replaces the list, "" clears): label = review only PRs carrying one (opts in when --review off), !label = skip PRs carrying it

--learnings-scope.description: Which repositories’ learnings the AI review reads (default auto): local = the reviewed repository, global = every repository in this workspace, auto = local for public / global for private repositories

--override-reviewers-only.description: With --repo: only the PR's reviewers (requested by name, or who already submitted a review; never the PR author) may `@uselumo ignore pre-merge checks` (default off)

--path-filter.description: With --repo (repeatable; replaces the list, "" clears): what the AI review and hunt read; !glob excludes, glob restricts to matches; lockfiles and generated files are excluded by default

--path-instruction.description: With --repo (repeatable; replaces the list, "" clears; ≤20): extra AI review instructions for files matching the glob, e.g. "scripts/**=Flag any console.log". They add checks, never remove one

--profile.description: With --repo: which findings get inline comments — quiet = only HIGH and Done-blocking (MEDIUM and path-instruction findings listed in the summary), chill (default) = HIGH, MEDIUM and any finding a path instruction asked for, assertive = LOW too. Never changes detection or what blocks Done

--repo.description: One connected repository: change it with the --repo settings above

--request-changes.description: Request-changes workflow (default off): Lumo requests changes while threads or Done-blocking findings are open, approves when clean

--review.description: With --repo: review every PR without a task automatically

--reward-hack.description: Agent behavior check: whether the agent sessions behind a PR gamed tests or checks (advisory)

--scan.description: Master switch: off = no layer runs, no PR comment

--sequence-diagrams.description: With --repo: a Mermaid sequence diagram of each PR's main call flow in the walkthrough of Lumo's summary comment (default on; trivial PRs never get one). `@uselumo diagram` on a PR draws it again

--summary.description: With --repo: where Lumo's high-level summary of each PR goes — description (default) = into the PR description (at an `@uselumo summary` line, else appended) and kept in sync on every review, comment = only in Lumo's summary comment, off = nowhere. Lumo only edits its own section of the description

--task-details-on-public-repos.description: With --repo: quote the linked Lumo task's requirements on a PUBLIC repository's PRs too (default off: only the item and its outcome are shown there; private repositories always show them)

--title-check.description: With --repo: the pre-merge title check (default warning); error = a failed check keeps Lumo at "Changes requested" (request-changes workflow on) until fixed or `@uselumo ignore pre-merge checks`

--title-requirements.description: With --repo ("" clears): extra rules the PR title must meet, in plain language

--tone.description: With --repo ("" clears; ≤250 chars): how the AI review words its findings and PR description, and Lumo its answers on the PR — wording only

workspace security-scan update.description: Change the PR security-scan and AI review settings, workspace-wide or for one repository (--repo). OWNER only; turning things off needs --confirm.

worktree.description: Scaffold, remove, list and prune per-task git worktrees under .worktrees/. Repo-specific links/copies/notes come from .lumo/worktree.json. Local dev tooling; run add/rm from the main checkout.

codex.detail: creates/removes git worktrees and branches (list: local git only)

--base.description: Branch off this ref instead of the remote default branch (skips fetch)

--confirm.description: The user has seen and approved the verifyCommand shown in the confirmation envelope. Only meaningful with --verify.

--no-fetch.description: Do not fetch the remote default branch before branching

--verify.description: Run verifyCommand from .lumo/worktree.json in the new worktree to confirm a clean baseline. Without --confirm, exits 4 showing the exact command and creates nothing.

worktree add.description: Create a worktree at .worktrees/<LUM-N>[-slug] on branch lumo/<LUM-N>[-slug] off origin/HEAD and apply .lumo/worktree.json. Run from the main checkout.

--json.description: Print { version, worktrees, total, nextCursor } as JSON

worktree list.description: List worktrees under .worktrees/: task id, branch, dirty state, and whether node_modules is symlinked.

--confirm.description: The user has approved the change shown in the confirmation envelope. Without it the command exits 4 and prints what it would do.

worktree prune.description: Remove the worktrees of DONE tasks, keeping any with uncommitted or unpushed work or the current directory inside. Without --confirm exits 4 with an envelope. Never deletes branches.

--confirm.description: The user has approved the change shown in the confirmation envelope. Without it the command exits 4 and prints what it would do.

--delete-branch.description: Also delete the branch (git branch -d; refuses if unmerged)

--force.description: Remove even with uncommitted changes (discards them)

worktree rm.description: Remove a task's worktree. Without --confirm (or with uncommitted changes and no --force) exits 4 with an envelope naming what would be discarded. Keeps the branch unless --delete-branch.
